rationale: The agent located the user via name and ZIP and reviewed multiple orders, but then executed a return without first confirming the specific item or refund method, violating the policy requirement to confirm any order-changing action. It also processed the refund to a gift card despite the user’s stated preference for credit card and without establishing that a credit card refund was impossible. The agent neither sought confirmation of which of the two tablets was the more expensive one nor verified with the user before submitting the return. These are clear policy violations, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
